OPT-001.symptom: Optical Transceiver Signal Loss / Rx Power Below Threshold (-24.0 dBm)
OPT-001.description: The primary SFP28 WAN interface indicates severe optical carrier attenuation. Rx optical power has dropped below -24.0 dBm operating limit.
OPT-001.technician_authorization_boundary: Level 1 operator may clean optical connectors and verify patch panel mating. Transceiver replacement inside energized chassis requires Certified Field Technician.
initial_isolation_checks: Inspect patch cord LC connector mating and verify latch engagement.
Check optical Tx/Rx polarity orientation on transceiver port 1.
Execute CLI command 'show interfaces wan0 optical-diagnostics' to read Rx power levels.
Inspect optical dust caps and clean LC ferrule using standard lint-free fiber cassette cleaner.

ERR-ARPX-101.symptom: WAN Optical Transceiver Signal Loss (Rx Loss of Signal / LOS asserted)
ERR-ARPX-101.description: The primary SFP28 WAN interface indicates loss of optical carrier signal. Optical Rx power drops below -24 dBm threshold.
ERR-ARPX-101.technician_authorization_boundary: Level 1 operator may clean optical connectors and verify patch panel patching. Chassis opening or optical transceiver replacement inside hot enclosure requires Certified Field Technician.
initial_isolation_checks: Inspect patch cord LC connector mating and verify latch engagement.
Check optical Tx/Rx polarity orientation on transceiver port 1.
Execute CLI command 'show interfaces wan0 optical-diagnostics' to read Rx power levels.
Inspect optical dust caps and clean LC ferrule using standard lint-free fiber cassette cleaner.

ERR-ARPX-204.symptom: BGP Peer Session Flapping / Route Convergence Exhaustion
ERR-ARPX-204.description: External BGP session resets cyclically due to TCP hold timer expiry or prefix limit exceeding allocated TCAM capacity.
ERR-ARPX-204.technician_authorization_boundary: Operator can adjust prefix limits and soft-reset peering via management plane. Core routing engine firmware flashing requires Tier-3 Network Architect authorization.
initial_isolation_checks: Check BGP neighbor state using 'show ip bgp summary' and review hold time negotiations.
Inspect CPU utilization on Control Processor Core 0 via 'show system resources'.
Verify MTU configuration matches peer link standard (1500 vs 9000 bytes).
Inspect prefix filter list to confirm total inbound routes do not exceed 1,500,000 prefixes.

ERR-ARPX-310.symptom: High Internal Junction Thermal Warning (Junction Temp > 88 C)
ERR-ARPX-310.description: Central ASIC thermal sensor reports temperature exceeding safe operating threshold. Throttling protocol activated.
ERR-ARPX-310.technician_authorization_boundary: External air inlet cleaning and ambient room temperature verification allowed for site operator. Internal chassis fan module replacement or heatsink repasting requires Authorized Field Technician.
initial_isolation_checks: Check ambient server room rack intake temperature (must not exceed 25 C).
Inspect front and rear chassis air grilles for physical dust accumulation.
Run 'show system environment thermal' to compare sensor readings across zones 1 through 4.
Verify all 4 counter-rotating pulse-width modulated (PWM) fans report RPM above 6000.

ERR-ARPX-402.symptom: Non-Volatile Memory (NVRAM) Checksum Mismatch / Hardware Integrity Fault
ERR-ARPX-402.description: System integrity check failed on secondary flash partition during boot verification. Potential flash memory corruption.
ERR-ARPX-402.technician_authorization_boundary: MANDATORY HALT: Physical flash module replacement or JTAG recovery requires Authorized Field Technician with ESD grounding kit and signed cryptographic recovery token.
initial_isolation_checks: Record system serial number, active boot partition, and hardware revision.
Export crash dump log via 'system dump export tftp://<server>/dump.bin'.
Do NOT power cycle or restart chassis to prevent persistent boot-loop state.
Halt diagnostic procedure immediately and request emergency hardware technician dispatch.

ERR-ARPX-505.symptom: Dual Redundant Power Supply (PSU-2) Phase Loss or Voltage Sag
ERR-ARPX-505.description: Secondary power module input voltage measured below 90 VAC or 0 VDC. Redundant power topology compromised.
ERR-ARPX-505.technician_authorization_boundary: Operator can inspect AC cord seating and PDU breaker state. Hot-swap replacement of PSU module requires Authorized Field Technician if input source breaker cannot be isolated.
initial_isolation_checks: Verify C14 power cable is fully latched into PSU-2 rear receptacle.
Inspect rack PDU branch circuit breaker feeding PSU-2 feed line B.
Verify front LED panel status: PSU-1 (Solid Green), PSU-2 (Flashing Amber or Off).
Execute 'show system power' to view input voltage, output wattage, and thermal readings on PSU-2.

ERR-CS4K-108.symptom: ASIC Packet Buffer Allocation Exhaustion / Ingress Drops
ERR-CS4K-108.description: Shared ingress packet buffer pool occupancy reached 99.2%. Tail drops observed on priority queues 4 through 7.
ERR-CS4K-108.technician_authorization_boundary: Software QoS tuning and microburst profile adjustment allowed for network operators. Buffer memory hardware testing requires vendor escalation.
initial_isolation_checks: Inspect queue drop counters via 'show interfaces priority-queue counters'.
Check for microburst traffic patterns on 100GbE uplink trunks.
Verify Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) and Priority Flow Control (PFC) parameters.
Enable dynamic buffer profile: 'config qos buffer-profile dynamic-auto'.

ERR-CS4K-215.symptom: Backplane Fabric Bus CRC Error Rate Exceeds 10^-5 Threshold
ERR-CS4K-215.description: High serial bit error rates detected across SerDes lanes connecting Line Card 2 to Central Crossbar Switch Module.
ERR-CS4K-215.technician_authorization_boundary: MANDATORY HALT: Physical line card reseat, alignment pin inspection, and backplane trace diagnostics require Authorized Field Technician with calibrated torque screwdriver and ESD protection.
initial_isolation_checks: Execute 'show fabric backplane errors linecard 2' to capture lane-by-lane bit error rates.
Isolate Line Card 2 traffic by shifting routing metrics to redundant card 1.
Do NOT unlatch or reseat line card during active production traffic.
Generate backplane diagnostic package and dispatch Tier-3 hardware field engineer.

ERR-CS4K-330.symptom: PoE+ Power Budget Overdraft on Line Card 3 (Exceeds 740W Limit)
ERR-CS4K-330.description: Total requested PoE power on 48-port Line Card 3 exceeds internal transformer thermal rating. Ports entering safety cutoff.
ERR-CS4K-330.technician_authorization_boundary: Site administrator can re-assign port priorities (Critical, High, Low) and disable unused PoE ports via software.
initial_isolation_checks: Execute 'show power inline linecard 3' to audit consumption per port.
Identify Class 4 and Class 6 high-draw PoE endpoints (PTZ cameras, high-power APs).
Reconfigure non-critical ports to low priority to prevent line card global cutoff.
Audit building cabling runs to verify resistance losses do not exceed 12.5 ohms per loop.

ERR-CS4K-412.symptom: Fan Tray 2 Tachometer Signal Loss / Rotor Lock Alert
ERR-CS4K-412.description: Hall effect sensor on Fan Tray 2 reports 0 RPM for Fan Units 3 and 4. Chassis operates on N+1 emergency cooling profile.
ERR-CS4K-412.technician_authorization_boundary: MANDATORY HALT: Modular fan tray extraction and replacement while chassis is energized requires Authorized Field Technician to adhere to hot-swap safety clearance limits (maximum 180 seconds extraction window).
initial_isolation_checks: Check chassis environment telemetry via 'show environment fan'.
Inspect Fan Tray 2 physical status LED on rear chassis panel (Red indicates rotor lock).
Verify adjacent fan trays 1 and 3 are compensating at 100% full speed.
Prepare hot-swap replacement fan tray (FRU-CS4K-FAN-R) and halt for certified technician.

ERR-CS4K-520.symptom: Cryptographic HSM Tamper Alert / Secure Enclave Locked
ERR-CS4K-520.description: Physical tamper detection circuit triggered on motherboard crypto coprocessor. Encryption keys zeroized as defensive measure.
ERR-CS4K-520.technician_authorization_boundary: MANDATORY HALT: Physical inspection, cryptoprocessor re-commissioning, and key vault re-provisioning require Authorized Security Field Engineer with dual-custody authorization keys.
initial_isolation_checks: Document physical chassis seals on top cover and rack security brackets.
Review management console audit log for unexpected chassis intrusion sensor triggers.
Do NOT attempt firmware overwrite or hardware reset.
Immediately escalate to Enterprise Security Operations and Certified Hardware Engineering.
